title: Semantic-Aware Random Convolution and Source Matching for Domain Generalization in Medical Image Segmentation (SRCSM)
mechanism: Random convolution applied differently to each labelled region during training, plus test-time intensity mapping of target images towards the source distribution.
evidence: Beats prior DG methods in most cross-modality and cross-centre abdominal, whole-heart and prostate settings; matches the in-domain baseline in several (abstract).
adaptation: Region-wise random conv on structural classes only; at test time, histogram-match each new-module cell to the training intensity distribution, trained jointly with the randomisation.
min_experiment: PF+SRCSM vs PF, 5 seeds; metric E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: < +0.02 over GIN-IPA arm.
prior_overlap: Partial: global intensity normalisation at inference failed (BRIEF), but without training-time region randomisation. Open.
